title: Image of the code projection lies in the code
statement: Let $C$ be a subspace of the $n$-qubit Hilbert space $\mathcal{H}_n$, and let $P_C : \mathcal{H}_n \to \mathcal{H}_n$ be the orthogonal projection onto $C$. Then for every $x \in \mathcal{H}_n$, the projected vector $P_C\,x$ belongs to $C$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a subspace of the n-qubit Hilbert space
x is a vector in the n-qubit Hilbert space
replaced: For any $x \in \mathcal{H}_n$, the projected vector $P_C\,x$ belongs to the code subspace $C$.
